units.source_text: 《法华经》云：灵鹫山在印度摩揭陀国王舍城东北，释迦牟尼涅槃（即死）后常住此山。

en.t: According to the Lotus Sutra, Vulture Peak lies northeast of Rajagriha in the Indian kingdom of Magadha; after Shakyamuni entered nirvana (that is, died), he continued to dwell on this mountain.

units.source_text: 又云：“释尊入灭，如薪尽火灭。”

en.t: It also says, "When the World-Honored One entered nirvana, it was like a fire going out when the firewood is exhausted."
